# migrate-design-system

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use only for a requested migration. Inventory consumers and map semantic roles,
component APIs, states, themes, and accessibility. Plan rollback and necessary
compatibility. Migrate a bounded surface and compare before/after behavior.
An ordinary fix does not authorize migration. Do not assume all external
libraries or upstream sample implementations are present.
